import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Handle the case when n = 0 separately since the product over an empty range is 1
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [Finset.prod_range_zero]
  | succ n =>
    -- Cast the sum condition to real numbers for AM-GM application
    have h₁ : (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast at h₀ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    -- Apply weighted AM-GM inequality: geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean
    have h₂ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      have h₃ : ∀ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ (a x : ℝ) := by
        intro x hx
        exact NNReal.to_nonneg _
      -- Use the fact that if sum equals n and all terms are non-negative,
      -- then the product is at most 1 (AM-GM inequality)
      have h₄ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 
                (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
        · intro i hi
          exact h₃ i hi
        · intro i hi
          positivity
        · simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
          <;> field_simp
        · simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
          <;> field_simp
      -- Since the arithmetic mean equals 1, the geometric mean is at most 1
      have h₅ : (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
        rw [h₁]
        field_simp
      have h₆ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
        linarith
      -- Raise both sides to power (n+1) to get the product bound
      have h₇ : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        have h₈ : 0 ≤ ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.prod_nonneg
          intro i hi
          exact h₃ i hi
        have h₉ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := h₆
        have h₁₀ : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
          calc
            ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) = 
              ((∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
              field_simp
              <;> ring_nf
            _ ≤ 1 ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) := by gcongr
            _ = 1 := by simp
        exact h₁₀
      exact h₇
    -- Convert back to NNReal
    have h₃ : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x ≤ 1 := by
      norm_cast at h₂ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    exact h₃

    simp [Finset.prod_range_zero, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  | succ n =>
    -- Work in Reals
    have h₁ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast at h₀ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    
    have h₂ : ∀ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ (a x : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      exact NNReal.coe_nonneg _
      
    -- Define weights w(x) = 1 / (n + 1)
    let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)

    have h₃ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w x = 1 := by
      calc
        ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w x = ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) := rfl
        _ = (n + 1 : ℝ) * (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
          <;> field_simp
